name: Werewolf 🐺
desc:
Inspired by Wolfy, the online werewolf game (web & mobile)

In a village attacked every night by Werewolves, trust is scarce, and every word can be decisive. In this game of strategy, deduction, and manipulation, each player has the power to change the course of events.

🔍 Investigate and unmask the Werewolves
♟️ Play unique roles with special abilities
⚔️ Form alliances… or betray them
💰 Earn rewards by playing and surviving
🛍️ Collect items like werewolf skins and tombstones

Gather at least 5 players to start the game! 👥

THE GAME IS CURRENTLY IN BETA, SOME FEATURES ARE MISSING, AND BUGS MAY BE PRESENT!
